purpose.reason: Reel Pipeline is a held operator media-production pipeline whose full publishable loop never shipped; it is not currently a public acquisition product.

design.reason: Its local Studio, review, gallery, and operator interfaces are functional product surfaces rather than a canonical public landing page.

publicSurface.deploymentPurpose: Artifact intake and storage, not a marketing website

verification.repositoryStatus: Held pipeline with CLI, API, local Studio, review, gallery, and evidence surfaces
verification.ownerDecision: Reopen only after reducing to one bounded video-to-publication loop with explicit cost and operator-time limits

decision: Do not invent, host, SEO-audit, GEO-audit, or rank a public landing page while the product is held and lacks a shipped public loop. Preserve its local operator UI and revisit a public page only when that bounded loop is genuinely proven.
